$comment: The iPhone and Android app's launch and native canvas colour (A15). `active` picks the palette; `node scripts/native-canvas.mjs --apply` writes it into the colour asset, the launch screen, the splash images, the Capacitor config and Android's splash. To go back: `node scripts/native-canvas.mjs --set fairway --apply`. It ships only with a new app build. src/test/static/canvas-color-sync.test.ts pins each palette to its CSS token and every native copy to the active palette.
